language.title: Let's start with your language
language.body: Your journey is easier when details are clear.

welcome.title: Your car deserves your care.
welcome.subtitle: Log maintenance, track schedules, and know where your money goes. Step by step.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to keep up with your car.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Create your account to start tracking your car's maintenance.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.

verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: We sent you a link by email. Open it to continue setup.
verifyEmail.subtitleWithEmail: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to continue setup.

profileSetup.title: Your profile
profileSetup.subtitle: Add a photo and your name to show on your account.

errors.passwordMin: Password must be at least 6 characters

voice.title:
Say it out loud.
We'll organize it.
voice.body: Tell us what you did, then review the details before we save it to your vehicle's log.

reminders.title:
Today's step.
Peace of mind on schedule.
reminders.body: Know your upcoming maintenance, its date, and how it's calculated.

history.title:
Every maintenance
tells a part.
history.body: Keep your car's history. The original stays saved, and edits appear alongside it.

odometer.title: This is where we start calculating
odometer.label: Current odometer reading
odometer.body: This reading will help us calculate your upcoming maintenance schedule.
odometer.equipmentBody: Choose operating hours instead of kilometers.

firstLog.title: What was your last maintenance?
firstLog.body: One record is enough to start scheduling.
